title: Database package: Postgres client, migration runner, conventions
goal: A shared database package gives every lane a pooled Postgres client, a forward-only migration runner and agreed conventions, so schema work is uniform and safe.
scope_in: Kysely + `pg` client factory with pool settings (max 10, idle 30 s, connect timeout 5 s, statement_timeout 10 s, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout 15 s) read from config.

Migration runner: plain SQL files in packages/db/migrations named `<yyyymmddhhmmss>_<snake_name>.sql`, applied in order inside a transaction, tracked in table `schema_migrations(version, name, checksum, applied_at)`, advisory-lock guarded so two instances never migrate at once.
CLI `centcom-db migrate | status | new <name>` (no down migrations; each file ends with a `-- rollback note:` comment).
Helpers: `withTransaction(db, fn)` with serialization-failure retry (max 3), `expectedMigrationVersion()` for /readyz, `healthCheck(db)`.
packages/db/CONVENTIONS.md: table/column naming, text ids with prefix CHECK constraints, `created_at/updated_at timestamptz`, soft delete rules, expand-migrate-contract policy, index naming.
scope_out: Any application table (B008 and later feature lanes).
build_against: Integration tests use a real Postgres 16 started by the CI service container or local compose; the pure parts (file ordering, checksum) run without a database.
interfaces: `migrate(db, dir: string, opts?:{target?: string}): Promise<{applied: string[]}>`; `migrationStatus(db, dir)`.
`expectedMigrationVersion(dir: string): string` (latest file version) and `healthCheck(db): Promise<{ok: boolean; migrationsAtExpected: boolean}>`.
acceptance: Applying 3 sample migrations to an empty database creates them in version order; running again applies none and exits 0.
Editing an already-applied migration file makes `migrate` fail with a checksum-mismatch error and apply nothing.
Two concurrent `migrate` processes: exactly one applies, the other waits on the advisory lock and then applies nothing.
A migration failing midway leaves no partial changes and no row in schema_migrations.
`withTransaction` retries a forced serialization failure (SQLSTATE 40001) up to 3 times and then rethrows.
`healthCheck` returns `migrationsAtExpected:false` when the DB is one migration behind.
A query exceeding the statement timeout is cancelled (test sets 1 s and runs `pg_sleep(2)`).
tests: runner.test.ts: ordering, checksum, atomicity, lock (real Postgres).
tx.test.ts: retry on 40001, rollback on error, nested use rejected.
conventions.test.ts: lints migration files for the `-- rollback note:` footer and forbids DROP TABLE/COLUMN outside a `-- contract` phase marker.
guardrails: MUST use parameterised queries only; MUST NOT expose a raw string-SQL helper outside migrations.
MUST keep migrations forward-only and backward compatible with the previous release (expand -> migrate -> contract); destructive statements need an explicit `-- contract` marker.
MUST never log SQL parameters or connection strings.
MUST run migrations as a separate deploy step (CLI), not on API/relay boot.
failure_modes: Database unreachable -> createDb succeeds lazily, healthCheck reports ok:false, callers get a typed unavailable error (not a raw pg error).
Lock not acquired within 60 s -> migrate exits non-zero with a message naming the lock.
Pool exhausted -> queries wait at most 5 s then fail with an unavailable error; pool saturation metric exposed.
notes: Adds dependencies kysely, pg (MIT). Timestamp-based file names avoid number collisions between parallel lanes.
